captions.formal: Time-lapse traffic moves through a city intersection lined with yellow autumn foliage, including a blue bus and a brown truck beneath tall apartment buildings.
captions.sarcastic: A breathtaking display of efficiency: the blue bus and brown truck racing through the intersection as blurred streaks of pure productivity.
captions.humorous_tech: High-speed traffic packets streaming through the city intersection, though a blue bus and brown truck are clearly experiencing some latency.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A blue bus and a brown truck lead a colorful parade of cars, all rushing home like they suddenly remembered they left the oven on.

captions.formal: An orange kitten walks toward a stationary camera through a wooded area, lifting its paws as its tail rises and curls upward.
captions.sarcastic: A truly daring expedition: an orange kitten bravely conquers several feet of dirt while lifting its paws one at a time.
captions.humorous_tech: Orange kitten deploying to production through the woods, lifting paws one by one as its tail signals a successful build.
captions.humorous_non_tech: This orange kitten marches through the woods with the immense confidence of a tiny forest king claiming his dirt kingdom.

captions.formal: A woman in a beige jacket and orange top sits at a white desk in an office, typing on a keyboard while looking at a computer monitor.
captions.sarcastic: A breathtaking display of athletic endurance: shifting her gaze and typing on a keyboard for several seconds.
captions.humorous_tech: The woman types at her desk with the focused intensity of a developer debugging a critical production incident in real time.
captions.humorous_non_tech: She stares and types with the intensity of a woman trying to write an email that sounds polite but is actually a scream.

captions.formal: A waterfall cascades down a dark, rocky cliffside surrounded by green vegetation and dense foliage, creating a mist that partially obscures the rock face.
captions.sarcastic: Riveting action: a waterfall performs the daring feat of falling in the exact same spot for the entire clip.
captions.humorous_tech: This continuous waterfall is basically a data stream with zero latency, deployed to a lush production environment.
captions.humorous_non_tech: This water is throwing itself off a cliff with the kind of commitment usually reserved for people who promised to start their diets on Monday.

captions.formal: A camera pans across a city skyline at night, zooming toward a tapered building with vertical white stripes and blue accent lighting.
captions.sarcastic: A truly gripping cinematic journey, culminating in the breathtaking discovery of a building with vertical white stripes.
captions.humorous_tech: The camera zooms toward that tapered building with the speed and confidence of a developer pushing a hotfix directly to production.
captions.humorous_non_tech: This building is acting like the main character of the city, politely pushing all its neighbors out of the way just to show off its stripes.

captions.formal: White birds with black markings land on a concrete shoreline featuring grass patches, joining a group as darker birds arrive against a background of water and distant mountains.
captions.sarcastic: A truly gripping cinematic event: a group of birds deciding that this particular patch of concrete is the place to be.
captions.humorous_tech: New bird instances are deploying to the concrete shoreline, while a few dark-colored patches join the cluster to resolve a merge conflict.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The white birds are gathering on the concrete like a very exclusive party where the dark-colored birds just showed up without an invitation.

captions.formal: Pedestrians flood a busy city intersection with multi-story buildings. A blue bus, taxis, and a cyclist move through the crowds before a large white truck enters the frame.
captions.sarcastic: A truly daring feat of bravery: a single cyclist deciding that the middle of a pedestrian flood is the optimal place for a ride.
captions.humorous_tech: A massive wave of pedestrians attempts to merge into the intersection, creating a real-world merge conflict with taxis, a cyclist, and a white truck.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A sea of people floods the intersection with the collective urgency of a crowd that just heard a bakery is giving away free cake.

captions.formal: A person in yellow cleats kicks a white and blue Molten soccer ball across a green turf field at twilight as two players in blue and maroon shirts follow.
captions.sarcastic: A truly breathtaking display of athleticism: two people chasing a ball across a field while the sun politely disappears.
captions.humorous_tech: Running a live A/B test on the pitch to see which player can resolve the Molten ball request with the lowest latency.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Two people in blue and maroon shirts chase a Molten ball with the sheer desperation of humans hunting for the last slice of pizza.

captions.formal: Chopped red onions, mushrooms, and red peppers are tossed in a black frying pan over orange flames as steam rises against a dark background.
captions.sarcastic: A truly daring culinary feat: several vegetables being tossed into the air and then immediately landing back in the same pan.
captions.humorous_tech: Executing a series of rapid deployments for these vegetables, hoping they land back in production without any critical merge conflicts.
captions.humorous_non_tech: These vegetables are experiencing the thrill of a lifetime, only to find out they are still just dinner.

captions.formal: Raindrops fall through green leaves and dark branches as the camera tilts upward toward the canopy, where sunlight creates a glare and circular lens flares.
captions.sarcastic: A truly daring cinematic achievement: tilting a camera upward until the sun decides to blind us with a few lens flares.
captions.humorous_tech: The camera tilts up through the rain, only for the sun to trigger a critical system crash via lens flare.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The tree is just trying to enjoy a quiet shower before the sun decides to crash the party and blind everyone.

captions.formal: A person with blue eyes wears black-rimmed glasses while stylized blue and white computer code scrolls across the face and lenses against a dark background.
captions.sarcastic: A truly riveting cinematic experience: watching blue and white lines of code scroll across a pair of glasses while someone stares blankly ahead.
captions.humorous_tech: The face of a developer during a prod incident, watching the logs scroll by in a state of total system freeze.
captions.humorous_non_tech: He stares ahead with the intensity of someone trying to remember if he actually locked the front door.
